candidates.statement: Inventory's redis.reserve_inventory calls error at ~1050ms with 6 redis_operation_timeout 504 logs and 9 dependency_timeouts, propagating an ERROR gateway call to inventory (~1955ms) and driving checkout error-rate/latency.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side telemetry (server latency, saturation, connection counts) is absent; the timeout's underlying cause is not established.

report.explanation: Inventory traces show redis.reserve_inventory ERROR at ~1050ms, matching 6 redis_operation_timeout 504 logs and 9 dependency_timeouts; gateway's call to inventory errors at ~1955ms. Order/payment checkout spans are OK and gateway metrics/logs are healthy, so the bounded candidate is a redis timeout at inventory. Deployment record alone does not establish causation.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency, saturation, and connection metrics for the incident window
Inventory redis client timeout/retry configuration and pool settings
